assessment.materialFinding: The phrase about rewriting a full route difference as a residual could imply delta equals residual. It now explicitly retains subtraction of the kept-function independent reference. A ninth closing paragraph distinguishes product shares, reference residual and complete route difference. Website mass/revenue referents, PEF feasibility subject and formal ILCD conjunction were clarified.
answers: A whole basket describes matched functions. A product residual is one term of the full route comparison and still needs its retained-function reference subtraction. Algebra does not change PEF reporting permission.
Equivalent operating alternatives and the specified absorption condition support the ILCD conditional proxy when other prerequisites hold; those facts alone do not establish direct PEF displacement.

A documented buyer switch supplies effect/object evidence, while a different region or technology inventory may still fail the independently required representativeness test; prior branch eligibility remains.
Equal residuals under a common fully matched reference establish the stated arithmetic equality only. They do not prove equal rule applicability, evidence requirements or real market effects.
assessment.limits: Independent agent comprehension answers and local prose acceptance are not real-user learning evidence, human expert review or whole-book acceptance.
